settings_gitsync.commit_hint: Makes a local commit on every change. No network.
settings_gitsync.connect_accounts_hint: Connect accounts on the Git tab. SSH addresses (git@…) are not accepted.
settings_gitsync.diverged_explain: The server does not decide which side wins: choosing one discards the other (with a backup in a branch). Meanwhile nothing is pushed, fetched or committed; your edits here keep working.
settings_gitsync.diverged_manual_hint: To merge both sides, resolve over SSH (see the "Sync the state with a Git repository" page in the documentation) and click Resume.
settings_gitsync.git_not_installed: The git program is not installed on this server.
settings_gitsync.no_recovery_recipient: No recovery_recipient in config.toml: losing this server's config.toml means losing every secret, including the ones in the repository.
settings_gitsync.plaintext_explain: Syncing only turns on, and only commits, with none of these. Move them to secrets (on the environment-variables screen). A suspicion that is not really a secret can be marked "not a secret"; certainties cannot.
settings_gitsync.rejected_hint: Nothing was applied. Fix it in the repository with a new commit; the daemon retries on its own.
settings_gitsync.removed_explain: These items disappeared from the state through a repository commit. The container, volumes and data were NOT touched. The domain goes offline. To clean up: Runtime → Containers → Stop → Remove (and Volumes, if there is data). If it was a mistake, undo the commit in Git: the service comes back and finds its container again.
settings_gitsync.sync_hint: Commits, pushes to the repository and fetches what was changed from outside (every 60 s, or on "Sync now").
settings_gitsync.versions_the_state: Versions the state (projects, services, jobs and encrypted secrets) in a private repository on your Git provider. Off by default. It only turns on if there is no plaintext value.
settings_maintenance.0_does_not_filter_b: 0 does not filter by age. The runtime looks at the image's creation date, not the last use: old base images remain eligible.
settings_maintenance.0_removes_all_unuse: 0 removes all unused cache. With a deadline, the cache of a recent job or deploy survives and the next build does not start from scratch.
settings_maintenance.after_cleaning_rebu: After cleaning, rebuilds the image of each service with a Git repository or zip, one at a time, in the deploy queue. Without it, the first deploy after the cleanup pays for the whole build.
settings_maintenance.keep_the_cache_used: KEEP THE CACHE USED IN THE LAST (HOURS)
settings_maintenance.only_images_created: ONLY IMAGES CREATED MORE THAN (HOURS) AGO
settings_maintenance.runs_by_itself_at_t: Runs by itself, at the time below, the resources ticked on this screen. Off by default — nothing is removed until you tick at least one resource and turn it on.
settings_maintenance.unused_volumes_crea: Unused volumes created outside rustploy (not by your services, which only use bind mounts) may hold data nobody would recreate by themselves. Confirm you know what exists on the host before turning it on.

settings_updates.there_is_a_new_version_: There is a new version. For now the update is manual: run the command below on the VPS. Your data, config.toml and age.key are preserved, and the services' containers keep running.

settings_web.base64_of_host_port_token_s: base64 of host:port::token — server address + token in a single string. It is what you paste into the GUI and webui login, and what an AI agent uses in POST /api/login. The daemon also leaves it in config.toml, under [api].connection_token. It is worth as much as the token: do not share it lightly.
settings_web.derived_from_api_domain_por: Derived from [api] domain/port in the daemon — it is the base of the services' webhook URLs and of the OAuth callback (same port as the API). To change it, set api.domain and restart the daemon.
settings_web.each_button_copies_this_ser: Each button copies this server's MCP entry for the matching agent, already with the token. Claude Code and Gemini: paste into a terminal; Codex: add the block to ~/.codex/config.toml. Open a new agent session and check with /mcp. It contains the token: do not paste it anywhere public.
settings_web.exposes_the_built_in_docker: Exposes the built-in Docker registry via ingress + automatic certificate. Requires [registry] enabled = true in the config. Empty = reachable only at 127.0.0.1.
settings_web.tls_certificates_issued_aut: TLS certificates issued automatically. Requires a daemon restart.

settings_gitsync.download_infra_help: Downloads a .zip with the same files the sync writes to the repository (settings.yml, providers.yml and projects/<id>/project.yml), with secrets encrypted. It is a copy outside GitHub. To restore, put the tree in a repository and sync.
settings_backups.destination_hint: Where the data of your services is copied to. Any S3-compatible storage works (AWS, Backblaze, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, RustFS). One destination per server; each service chooses its own schedule in its Data tab.
settings_backups.no_recovery_recipient: No recovery key is configured. Backups are encrypted, so without one they could only be opened by this server and could not restore a new one. Set [secrets] recovery_recipient in config.toml first.
settings_backups.path_style_hint: On for MinIO, RustFS, R2 and Backblaze (host/bucket/key). Off for AWS S3 (bucket.host/key).
settings_backups.secret_key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
settings_backups.secret_key_saved: A secret key is saved on the server. It is never shown again.
settings_recover.title: RECOVER THIS SERVER
settings_recover.intro: On a new, clean server: brings the infrastructure from the git repository, restores the data from the S3 backups and starts everything in dependency order. Only works on a server with no projects.
settings_recover.key_hint: The private key stays only in the server's memory during the recovery and is discarded at the end. Only the public key goes to config.toml.
settings_recover.ready_hint: Nothing has started yet. When you confirm, each service gets its data restored (volumes before starting, databases after) and starts in dependency order.
settings_language.choose_the_language_of: Choose the language of the app. The choice is remembered.
O log desta execução será excluído e não: This execution's log will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
) serão excluídas e não poderão ser recu: ) will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
dados.title: SERVICE DATA
dados.intro: Takes this service's data to a file (.rpdata) and brings it back into another service of the same kind, here or on another server. The service configuration goes separately (Export service). Requires the master key. For plain volumes, the service is stopped during the copy and restarted afterwards.
Isto SUBSTITUI os dados atuais do serviç: This REPLACES the service's current data. Click again to confirm.
dados.encrypt: Encrypt the package (age). It only opens on a server with the same identity or the recovery key.
dados.s3_backup_intro: Copies this service's data (encrypted) to the S3 destination set in Settings → Backups, and brings it back in one click. Nothing is ever uploaded in plain text.
dados.s3_policy_enable: Turn on automatic backup for this service
dados.s3_policy_stop: Stop the service during the copy (recommended)
Os backups que já estão no S3 continuam: The backups already in S3 stay there. New ones will not be sent until you set another destination.
Isto SUBSTITUI os dados atuais do serviç: This REPLACES the service's current data with the chosen backup.
Cada serviço tem os dados restaurados do: Each service gets its data restored from S3 (volumes before starting, databases after) and starts in dependency order.
job_env.title: Variables and secrets · {job_env_name}
job_env.hint: For a sensitive value, use a secret: write <secret:NAME> or secret:NAME as the value here or in the .env editor, or use 🔒 on a variable. The job sees its own secrets first, then the trigger service's, then the project's.
job_env.job_secrets_hint: Encrypted values used only by this job (they win over a trigger-service or project secret with the same name). The real value never comes back here: saving with an existing name replaces it, and applies on the next run.
job_env.no_job_secret: No secret in this job yet.

new_job_window.env_hint_edit: Manage this job's variables and secrets (encrypted), with the same buttons as a service.
new_job_window.env_hint_create: After you create the job, the next step lets you add its variables and secrets, with the same buttons as a service.
